about: Route table read by reconcile.py: the routes the Phase 3 rulings name and the cleaner names for clumsy mechanical routes. Every entry cites the decision (decisions.json) or the convention it follows. 'bases' rename a resource's route base (singleton: no :id; idParam: the id's name). 'actions' and 'reads' are keyed by canonical Resource.action / Resource, or screen:RawEntity(.action) for one screen, or screen:* for every read of a screen. A read set to {drop: decision} makes no endpoint; an action set to {ruling: decision} maps to that ruling. 'endpointBody' (keyed 'METHOD /path') applies a decision to one endpoint's body: drop names fields removed, set adds or retypes fields, response names what it returns. 'extraFields' adds the fields (and so the resource) a decision names when no screen or declaration carries them. dropFields: a field a decision takes off a resource's shape.

WebhookEvent.refundWebhook.decision: conventions naming (Paystack posts every event to one signed URL)
